---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new feature for MusicNest
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

### 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you are proposing.

---

### 🎯 Problem Statement
Does this feature solve a specific problem or improve an existing workflow? (e.g., *"I find it difficult to organize long playlists when..."*)

---

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Implementation Idea
Describe how you envision this feature working in the UI or backend architecture.

---

### 🔍 Alternatives Considered
Mention any alternative solutions, third-party implementations, or workarounds you have tested.

---

### 📸 Mockups / References
Attach sketches, screenshots from other players, or visual references if applicable.
